CustomObject.description: What the data explorer may never read, on top of the rep's own access (user mode still applies to every query). Each row is one rule: an object name, an object-name suffix family, a field-name pattern, a field type, the only fields of one object, or a custom object an admin allows. Custom objects are denied until an Allow Object row names them, and a deny always beats an allow. An empty or unreadable list refuses every object (docs/research/fr2-explorer-catalog.md).
CustomObject.label: Explore Deny Rule
